beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Replacing a Schoology sample uses a simple Replace or Cancel dialog. It identifies the student, course, learning period, school year, current assignment, and proposed replacement assignment.

Fixes:
• Fixed replacement incorrectly reporting that the original sample was missing when its source files were present in a backup folder.
• Undo preserves original source folders, including appended sources, along with the saved PDF and verification status.
• Improved long duplicate-sample labels, duplicate-review sizing across monitors, and remembered workspace folder names.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Missing Schoology work now offers a direct assignment link and a Reload action in the center of the viewer.
• Reload checks Schoology again and downloads newly submitted work automatically.

Fixes:
• Fixed course-card clicks opening a different student's course or assignment. The selected student and course now stay together through grading.
• Fixed missing-assignment links sending signed-in teachers to the generic Schoology login page.
